_comment: Real response shapes from the Equavia MCP server. Captured 2026-08-01. Build against these exact structures — do not invent fields.

get_workouts._note: Returns last 7 days across all exercises when called with no date. IMPORTANT: `weight` sits on the PARENT object, not on individual sets. All sets in an entry therefore share one weight. This means reverse-pyramid sets (different weight per set) CANNOT currently be represented. The status panel must not assume per-set weight exists.

sets.reps: number — the rep target for the entry
sets.weight: number — one weight for all sets

get_health._note: NOT live. This is a snapshot written whenever health.html was last opened on any device. ALWAYS read the `at` field and surface its age in the UI — a recovery gate firing on three-day-old data is misleading. Fields may be null (steps and activeKcal frequently are), so guard every read.

_shape.at: ISO 8601 — when this snapshot was written, NOT when it was requested

_gate_thresholds._note: Recovery bands used by the status panel. Applied to `recovery`, with `hrvTrend` as a secondary signal.

_indicator_lifts._note: Match on these exercise name strings as they appear in get_workouts. Names must match exactly or progression tracking silently returns nothing. Verified against the real po_coach_v1.exercises roster (docs/exports/po-coach-2026-08-02T11-03-06-103Z.json) on 2026-08-02 -- A2 matched exactly as 'Overhead Press'. A1, B1, A5 have no match in the current roster: 'Incline Machine Press' exists but is a different exercise (machine, not DB -- that's A3's movement, not A1's; an orphaned log key 'tr_incline_dumbbell_press' suggests a DB variant was created at some point, but it's not in the current roster and holds zero logged sets, so there's nothing real to point A1 at); no chin-up/pull-up movement exists for B1; 'Incline Hammer Curl' exists but is a different exercise from A5's slot. A1/B1/A5 are left as the intended target names -- do not substitute a different movement just because something vaguely adjacent exists -- and resolve once the new programme's exercises enter the log from 2026-08-03.

_known_gaps: No per-set weight — RPT loads cannot be stored or read.
No session completion record — a missed session is inferred from a training day with zero logged sets.
No waist or arm measurements anywhere. These need adding as inputs.
No session feel / subjective rating. Needed for the December volume decision.
'Weighted chin-up' and 'Hammer curl' do not yet appear in the log — they enter with the new programme on 2026-08-03.
